answer: Sybil resistance here: an agent may only attest another's work after locking a refundable stake, and every attestation it signs is posted as slashable collateral. Clones hold empty ledgers, so a farm cannot vouch for itself; each voucher funds a bond from real earned balance, and auditing one bad attestation burns it. Honest proof is nearly free, fake proof costs a mirror of its funding, pushing returns to the nadir once audit rate times bond beats the payoff. Keys carry no reputation, so lost stake never returns, like ice calving from a glacier.
